verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe user-configurable background automations: custom Auto Labels defined by AI prompts, Auto Archive, Auto Drafts generated for every message needing a reply, and automatic follow-up reminders that run as mail arrives. The docs also describe agents built via chat or a visual builder that 'run proactively based on triggers you set.' Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the trigger-based agent builder (only one thin mention), independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably unattended, and custom Auto Labels being limited to Business/Enterprise plans.
